_comment: SHR-004. Every canon contradiction this tree currently carries, acknowledged with an owner and the PR that will close it. This is an AUDIT-ONLY record: PR 01 detects, PR 02 and PR 03 fix. Drift is an error in both directions — a finding that appears without an entry here fails the build (NEW), and an entry here that no longer reproduces also fails the build (DROPPED), so fixing a contradiction without retiring its acknowledgement is caught too. Finding ids are (surface, rule), never line numbers, so reflowing a paragraph does not invent a finding.

findings.excerpt: 8 of 8 command entries carry no status label
findings.why_open: SHR-005 requires every public capability to be labelled runtime, adapter, contract, or experimental. Skills and agents are fully labelled; commands are not labelled at all. Adding the labels means editing shiroe-registry.json and extending the schema, which is registry parity work, not audit work.

findings.excerpt: 9 of 9 team-pack entries carry no status label
findings.why_open: Same gap as commands: the schema defines the status enum only under skills and agents, so team_packs entries have nowhere to declare one.

findings.excerpt: 5 of 5 gate entries carry no status label
findings.why_open: Same gap as commands and team_packs. Gates are the most consequential of the three to mislabel, since a gate advertised as runtime but implemented as contract would silently not run.

findings.excerpt: ledger says 82 test files, tree has 83
findings.why_open: Self-inflicted and deliberate: this PR adds tests/test_canon_consistency.py, which moves a number README.md states as prose. Left open as the working proof that the ledger detects a PR changing a published count. Fixing it means making the count a generated surface instead of hand-maintained text.

findings.excerpt: public cap is 4 (README.md, AGENTS.md x2); team-packs/enterprise.md declares agents_active: 6
findings.why_open: Three public surfaces publish a hard cap of 4 agents per pack while a shipped pack declares 6. One side is wrong and only a human can say which: raising the published cap changes the product promise, lowering enterprise.md changes shipped behaviour.
